display_name: Working away from the office: spot it
description: An awareness episode of about 8 minutes for staff who work away from the office, on the sorting side only. Working away from Tarrowby Logistics, a fictional haulier: the café's real Wi-Fi and a look-alike, a page that wants your work password, a genuine lost-device notice and a fake one. Each answer is explained, and reporting when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down. No real network is joined and no real password is typed.
